store_in_manager_memory: lessons learned from using CRM MCP
short journal entries after important work
durable conclusions extracted from owner-provided files
reusable routing rules from playbooks and source catalogs
sensitive_data_rule: Keep secrets out of Git-tracked docs. Store only operational notes that are safe to keep in the project.
crm_reference_rule: If memory needs to reference CRM data, store a short note with CRM ids or search terms, not the full record.
file_intake_rule: If a new file changes a durable rule, extract the rule, update the relevant playbook or catalog, and keep the raw file out of memory.
